explanation: The new city that God prepares for his people, described as a great city with walls of gold and foundations adorned with precious stones.
His presence among humanity in the new creation where he will wipe every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or sorrow.
The renewed heaven that comes down to earth, symbolizing God's full involvement in the world without the separation of sin.
The earth cleansed from all injustice and corruption, where righteousness will dwell and life will flourish forever.
A tree that bears fruit every month and whose leaves are for the healing of the nations in the new creation.
The metal describing purity, value, and God's glory in the city's streets and foundations.
The gemstones on the gates and foundation of the city representing the twelve tribes of Israel and the apostles.
Christ as the symbol of the sacrificial lamb for salvation, whose light shines over the new creation without need for sun or moon.
A clear river flowing from God's throne and giving eternal life to all who thirst in the heavenly Jerusalem.
